assets.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: full-bleed wedding website background, tall portrait 1:2 aspect ratio. Input image is the edit target, a three-panel design board. Extract ONLY the LEFT panel (the palace and blue winter river), preserving the original scene precisely. Output ONLY this single tall panel, no board, no margins, no other panels. Do NOT redesign or reinterpret the scene. Preserve exact palace architecture, palace position approximately mid-height through 65%, snow-covered tall fir on left, snowy mountains, small illuminated gazebo lower left, dark blue reflective river winding through foreground, moon on upper right, deep navy stars and clouds. Carefully remove ALL typography, text, date numerals, tiny snowflake dividers, divider lines, bottom arrow and UI elements; reconstruct matching sky/river behind them. The sky in the upper 38% should stay clean and dark blue for later live text, using the existing sky and clouds without moving the moon. Only allowed additive edit: very subtle translucent gauzy silver sheer wedding veil at the extreme BOTTOM CORNERS, occupying just the lower 10-15% height, softly draped in snow, leaving the river still clearly visible and never covering palace or gazebo. The river composition is the priority. All other original details must stay in their original relative locations. No text, no logos, no borders, no watermark. Natural high-detail winter fantasy photographic image, identical colors and lighting to original. Tall 1:2 portrait output.
